name: Claude Code Security Reviewer
summary: GitHub Action that uses Claude to review pull request diffs for security vulnerabilities and comment findings on the PR.
description: AI-powered security review GitHub Action. For pull requests it analyzes only the changed files, posts findings as review comments with severity and remediation, and filters common false positives such as DoS and open redirects. Inputs cover API key, model, excluded directories, timeout and custom scan instructions; a /security-review command brings the same analysis into Claude Code.
contains: diff-aware scanning of pull request changes
posts findings as PR review comments
detects injection, auth flaws, XSS, hardcoded secrets, RCE, supply chain risks
false-positive filtering (DoS, rate limiting, open redirects)
inputs: claude-api-key, claude-model (Opus 4.1 default), claudecode-timeout, exclude-directories
